outcome.answer: Use an asynchronous observability system that captures and stages internal tensors outside the inference hot path. DMI-Lib supports observation points for diverse internal signals and inference backends while preserving serving optimizations; it reports 0.4%–6.8% overhead in offline batch inference and an average of 6% in moderate online serving, with lower latency overhead than comparable baselines [7]. For multi-GPU models, another system collects full layer-wise activation trajectories while reducing activation memory and increasing throughput relative to its baseline [4].
